findings.description: The thresholds runtimes campaign22 (easy), campaign23 (hard) and campaign24 (chaos) were started with '-Dachievetodo.progression.freshConfig=true' in addition to the two -javaagent args. The brief requires the certified operator launch to carry no -Dachievetodo.* flags; only campaign21 and campaign25 match. The flag is read by BukkitProgressionRuntime.java:72 and changes config initialisation (line 401), so 3 of the 5 runtimes contributing rows to this group did not run the certified composition. All 5 runtimes do log ATD_LAUNCH_PROFILE=release and ATD_GAMEPLAY_MODE=CERTIFICATION (output.log lines 206-222) before the first case.

No locked vault row in any runtime shows the client lock overlay, and the server log has no explicit denial line (useBlock=ALLOW; ATD_STAGE2A_STATE shows UNLOCK_VAULT: null). The lock is proven only by the absence of an effect (key kept, no rewarded_players). NativeComplexBindings calls denialEffects.report for non-SILENT ids, so the missing message to the player may be a UX gap worth checking; it is not a gameplay leak.
